original: 触れるだけで\n生物に変化を及ぼす物質、か……
traducao: A substance that alters living beings\nmerely upon contact, huh...?

original: そんなものが\n本当に存在しているなら、\n大変な事になるな
traducao: If such a thing\ntruly exists, it will lead\nto momentous events.

original: そうね……
traducao: Yeah......

original: どうしてそんな恐ろしいものが\nいきなり出て来たのかしら……
traducao: Why would such a terrifying thing\nsuddenly appear out of nowhere...?

original: 理由はともかく、だ。\n重要なのは、生物を変質させるという\nその現象であり、事実
traducao: Regardless of why.\nThe important thing is the fact\nof that phenomenon altering biology.

original: オレの想像をはるかに超える\n貴重な生体サンプルが\n採取出来るかもしれん
traducao: We might be able to gather rare\nbiological samples that far exceed\nmy wildest imagination!

original: この地上に存在しない、別の何かに\n変化するだと……
traducao: Transforming into something else\nthat does not exist on this earth...

original: それが本当に事実なら\nサンプルを幾つ採取しても\n足りないくらいだ！
traducao: If that is truly factual,\nno amount of samples we collect\nwould ever be enough!

original: ルビア。\nその時はぜひ、\n君も採取に協力してくれ！
traducao: Rubia.\nWhen the time comes, by all means,\nyou must help me collect samples!

original: えっ……でも……
traducao: Eh... But...

original: よし。\nその物質とやらに、早く対面しに行こう
traducao: Right.\nLet us go meet this substance at once!

original: うう……。\nウィルさんの悪い病気が\n始まっちゃった……
traducao: Ugh...\nWill's bad habit has\nkicked in again...

original: 学者って、みんなこういう\nものなのかしら……。\nはぁ……
traducao: Are all scholars\nlike this, I wonder...?\n*sigh*...

original: これまでの魔物討伐数が\n８００体を超えたと聞いた。\n……すごいな、お前は
traducao: I heard you've slain over 800\nmonsters so far.\n...You're impressive.

original: ああ、オレも感心していたところだ。\nさすがはアドリビトムのホープと\nアンジュが言うだけはあるな
traducao: Indeed, I am thoroughly impressed too.\nAnge was right to call you\nthe hope of Ad Libitum.

original: それだけではないだろう。\n……○○からは\n何か、強い信念の様なものを感じる
traducao: That's not all.\n...From ○○,\nI feel a strong conviction.

original: ふむ……確かに、使命感だけで\n達成出来る数字ではないかもしれないな
traducao: Hm... Indeed, that number cannot be\nachieved through mere sense of duty.

original: ところで……
traducao: By the way...

original: オレは今、この世界で変質しつつある\n魔物の生態について、無性に語りたいんだが
traducao: Right now, I have an overwhelming urge\nto lecture on monster ecology changes!

original: 常々考えていたんだ。\n魔物の生態バランスに変化が\n生じるという事は、すなわち……
traducao: I have often pondered this.\nA shift in monster ecological balance\nmeans, in other words...

original: おい、ヴェイグ？\n話はまだ途中だぞ！
traducao: Hey, Veigue?\nI wasn't finished talking!

original: は……っくしょん！
traducao: A... Atchoo!

original: どうした。\n風邪か？
traducao: What is it?\nA cold?

original: あ、いえ……そうじゃないと思うんですけど\nどうもくしゃみが止まらなくて……
traducao: Ah, no... I don't think that's it,\nbut I can't stop sneezing...

original: ふむふむ……って事は、アレね
traducao: Hm-mm... In that case, it's that.

original: ああ。\n……アレだな
traducao: Ah.\n...It's that, indeed.

original: 「アレ」？　\n何ですか、それ？
traducao: "That"?\nWhat is "that"?

original: 特定の状況下で起きるくしゃみ……とくれば\nアレ以外にないだろう
traducao: Sneezing occurring under specific\ncircumstances... It could only be that.

original: そうねえ。　よりにもよって\nアレにかかっちゃうなんて……\nエミルも運がないわねえ？
traducao: Indeed. Of all things, catching that...\nEmil, you really are down on your luck,\naren't you?

original: な、何？　\nだから「アレ」って何なの？
traducao: Wh-What?!\nWhat do you mean by "that"?!

original: 気の毒にな……
traducao: Poor guy...

original: ほんとにねえ……
traducao: Truly...

original: もう！　\nもったいぶらないで\n教えてくれたって……
traducao: Geez!\nStop keeping me in suspense\nand just tell me already...!

original: は……はっくしゅ！
traducao: A... Atchoo!!

original: キール、学会から連絡は来たのか？
traducao: Keele, heard back from the academy?
...Y-Yeah...

original: その様子だと、あまり良い返答は\nもらえなかった様だな
traducao: From your look, you didn't receive\na very positive reply, did you?

original: すまない、ウィル……。\n色々協力してもらっているのに……
traducao: I'm sorry, Will...\nAfter all the help you've given me...

original: 気にする事はない。\n人間は間違える生き物だ。　正しい評価を\n一度で下せないのは、むしろ普通の事だ
traducao: Don't let it bother you. Humans are\nfallible. Failing to give proper credit\nat first is quite normal.

original: しかし……。\n学会の人間の理解を得られれば\nこの先の運営は、より円滑に……
traducao: Still... If we had the academy's\nsupport, our operations ahead would\nhave gone much more smoothly...

original: なに、そのうち向こうから進んで\n支援を申し出てくるさ
traducao: Don't fret. Before long, they'll come\noffering aid of their own accord.

original: それくらい、このプロジェクトは\n大きな試みになる
traducao: That is just how momentous an endeavor\nthis project will become.

original: ウィル……
traducao: Will...

original: あまり気を落とすな。\n学会だけじゃない、世間一般の認識との\n戦いはこれからだろう？
traducao: Don't lose heart. The struggle isn't\njust with the academy, but with public\nperception. It begins now, right?

original: ……まだ……戦いは始まってもいないと？
traducao: ...The battle hasn't even begun yet?

original: そうまでは言わないがな
traducao: I wouldn't go quite that far.

original: 他人の評価を全く気にするなとも言わん。\nだが、それが度を越すと、肩書きや名声にのみ\n価値を見出す人間になる…その事を忘れるなよ
traducao: I won't say ignore all evaluations.\nExcess, however, leads one to only value\ntitles and fame... Never forget that.

original: ウィルさんは、ジェイと\n面識があるんですよね？
traducao: Will, you're acquainted with Jay,\naren't you?

original: 情報屋と顧客……という関係でなら、\n何度かやり取りをした事はあるな
traducao: As an informant and a client, we have\ninteracted several times, yes.

original: ジェイが、どうかしたのか？
traducao: Did something happen with Jay?

original: いや……ただ、\nどんな人なんだろうと思って
traducao: No... I was just wondering\nwhat kind of person he is.

original: 何となくですけど\n少し陰があるというか、\n訳ありな雰囲気を感じるんですよ
traducao: Somehow, he seems somewhat shady,\nor rather, has an air of someone\nwith a complicated past.

original: ふむ……。\nジェイは、自分の過去の事を\n全くと言っていい程話さないからな
traducao: Hm... Jay rarely talks about his past,\nto the point of saying practically\nnothing at all.

original: 職業柄かもしれんが\nその辺りは、実に徹底しているぞ
traducao: Perhaps it's his profession, but\nhe is thoroughly guarded about it.

original: そうなんですか……
traducao: Is that so...?

original: 俺から言える事があるとしたら、\n一つだけだな。\nそれは……
traducao: If there is one thing I can tell you,\nit would be this alone.\nThat is...

original: それは、何ですか？
traducao: And what would that be?

original: 身長の話は、厳禁だという事だ
traducao: Bringing up his height is strictly taboo.

original: ……そ、そうなんですか。\n……一応、覚えておきます……
traducao: ...I-Is that so?\n...I'll keep that in mind, just in case.

original: ふう……
traducao: Phew......

original: 大分、疲れが溜まっている様だが。\nいかがされたかな？
traducao: You appear quite fatigued.\nWhat seems to be the matter?

original: いや、キールとフィリアに\n簡単な博物学のレクチャーを頼まれてな。\n少し教師まがいの事をしていたんだが……
traducao: Keele and Philia asked for a short\nlecture on natural history, so I played\nthe role of teacher a bit, but...

original: 幾つになっても、\n人にものを教えるというのは、\n大変な事だ
traducao: No matter how old one gets,\nteaching others is always\na challenging undertaking.

original: ふむ……。\n教える側は一人でも、教わる側は\n多種多様であるからな
traducao: Hm... Though the teacher is but one,\nthose who learn are diverse\nand varied.

original: 自分が理解出来るやり方と、\n相手が理解出来るやり方は違う。\nその難しさを、つくづく感じさせられた
traducao: The way I comprehend things differs from\nhow others understand. I was deeply\nreminded of that difficulty.

original: それでも、古来よりヒトは\n意思疎通から発展の糸口を手繰り\n繁栄してきた生き物だ
traducao: Even so, from ancient times, humans\nhave found keys to progress through\ncommunication, thriving as a species.

original: 目の前の難題の中にこそ\n本当に大切な何かが\n隠されているのかもしれん
traducao: It may well be that within the hardships\nbefore us, something truly precious\nlies concealed.

original: また、意味深な事を言うのだな
traducao: You speak with profound meaning again.

original: 無為に歳を重ねて来たわけでもないのでな。\n多少であれば、思わせぶりに話せるという\nだけの事
traducao: I haven't lived my years in vain.\nSpeaking with slight gravity is simply\nsomething that comes with age.

original: なるほど。\n勉強になる
traducao: I see.\nI have learned much.

original: は……、は……、\nは〜くしょんっ！
traducao: Ah... ah...\nAtchoo!!

original: あら、風邪？
traducao: Oh, a cold?

original: いや、何か、鼻が……、\nむずむず……、は〜くしょん！
traducao: No, my nose is kinda...\nticklish... Atchoo!

original: それって、花粉症じゃないかしら？
traducao: Could that be hay fever, perhaps?

original: 花粉症？
traducao: Hay fever?

original: 平たく言えば現代病の一種よ
traducao: Simply put, a kind of modern disease.

original: 花の花粉が粘膜に付くと、\nくしゃみとか鼻水とか涙とか止まらないの
traducao: When flower pollen hits mucus membranes,\nsneezes, runny nose, and tears won't stop!

original: へ……、へぇ〜〜。\nへぇーくしょい！
traducao: H-Heeeh~~\nAtchooey!

original: なら、ノーマは、\n流行の最先端を行っているわけね
traducao: Then you're on the cutting edge\nof the latest trends, Norma.

original: おっ、何かそれ、ちょっと格好いい∀
traducao: Ooh, that sounds kinda cool!

original: へくしょん！
traducao: Atchoo!

original: とは言え、病気だけどね
traducao: Even so, it's an illness.

original: そうね、病気よね
traducao: True, it's an illness.

original: ノーマ！　\nこんな所でサボってたか！\nほら、片付けの続きをやるぞ！！
traducao: Norma!\nSlacking off in a place like this?!\nBack to cleaning up, now!!

original: うぇ〜〜〜、ホコリまみれになるのいや〜
traducao: Uwaaah, I don't wanna get dusty~~

original: つべこべ言うな！
traducao: Stop your whining!

original: 違ったみたいね
traducao: Seems we were mistaken.

original: あたしは、可能性を言っただけだし
traducao: I merely stated a possibility.

original: 少し残念だったわ
traducao: That's a bit disappointing.

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Anger.\n
